title: How My Own Email Bots Run: Leads In, Replies Handled, Calls Booked

sections.label: 1 - FINDING AND RESEARCHING LEADS
sections.note: Every lead is verified before anything is sent, and every email opens with something true about that business.

sections.label: 2 - SENDING SAFELY
sections.note: Cold email never touches my main domain, and a bot watches inbox health every day.

sections.label: 3 - HANDLING EVERY REPLY
sections.note: A bot sorts each reply. Anything I haven't approved waits for me instead of going out on its own.

sections.label: 4 - BOOKING AND FOLLOWING UP
sections.note: Interested leads get call times right away, and quiet ones get followed up on a schedule.

sections.label: 5 - REPORTING
sections.note: I get the numbers twice a day without opening a single dashboard.

nodes.label: 1 - A bot pulls new businesses for each niche and verifies every email address
2 - Claude researches each business and writes a personal first line for them
3 - Instantly sends the campaigns from about 45 warmed inboxes on 15 domains
4 - A bot checks every inbox's health each day and flags anything that's slipping
5 - When someone replies, a bot reads it and sorts it into one of 11 types
6 - Is the right answer one of the replies I've already approved?
6b - If not, the bot drafts a reply and sends it to me to approve first
7 - If it is, it goes out and offers two open call times from my calendar
8 - If the lead goes quiet, a follow-up bot keeps checking in on a set schedule
9 - Booked calls land in my GHL pipeline and get reminders before the call
10 - Every morning and evening, a reporting bot sends me the numbers

input_sample.reply: Sounds interesting, what does this cost?

output_sample.sent: approved reply with two call times
